      <h2>A coastal hotel with a distinctly Sri Lankan soul.</h2>
      <p class="lede">Set near Ambalangoda, Sea Breeze brings together the Indian Ocean, tropical gardens, relaxed accommodation, dining and memorable event spaces.</p>
      <p class="body">The hotel grew from a seaside restaurant into a welcoming coastal property, keeping hospitality at the heart of the experience. Here, mornings begin in the garden, afternoons drift between the pool and beach, and evenings arrive in warm sunset light.</p>
